Sweet Flavor

Cacao Bean

About This Entry

Cacao Bean is a canonical whole agricultural cacao bean for roasting and nib production ingredient in global cookery — its sweetness character, texture, and pairing behavior pair with dessert wines, sparkling styles, and spice-friendly reds when used as a primary sweetener.
